intent: Sustained forward trot at 0.1 m/s on Sesame's 8-joint (2-DoF-per-leg) vertical-axis hips, using diagonal pairs A=(right_front,left_rear) and B=(right_rear,left_front) offset by half a cycle. Distinct gait variant from prior candidates: freq=2.46 Hz, hip amplitude 0.266 rad, hip center 1.607 rad, stance knee flex 0.15 rad, swing knee lift 0.575 rad, phase origin 0.115, constant base height 0.04673357 m.

phases.name: stance A / swing B (early)
phases.base_motion: Constant forward translation x=0.1*t, y=0, fixed base z=0.04673357 m, zero roll/pitch/yaw.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A (RF,LR) in stance: hips follow cosine wave around center, knees at stance flex 0.15 rad (R3=pi-0.15, L4=pi-0.15). Pair B (RR,LF) in swing: hips offset half cycle, knees lift via positive sine arch over normalized swing (R4=L3=0.15+0.575*sin(pi*sB)).

phases.name: stance A / swing B (late)
phases.base_motion: Constant forward translation x=0.1*t, y=0, fixed base z, zero rpy.
phases.limb_motion: Pair A continues stance cosine hip motion with stance knee flex; pair B swing arch peaks then returns toward stance flex, preparing touchdown at phase wrap.

phases.name: stance B / swing A (early)
phases.base_motion: Constant forward translation x=0.1*t, y=0, fixed base z, zero rpy.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B (RR,LF) now in stance with stance knee flex 0.15 rad; pair A (RF,LR) in swing with knee lift arch (R3=L4=0.15+0.575*sin(pi*sA)).

phases.name: stance B / swing A (late)
phases.base_motion: Constant forward translation x=0.1*t, y=0, fixed base z, zero rpy.
phases.limb_motion: Pair B stance cosine hip motion continues; pair A swing arch returns to stance flex, closing the cycle smoothly at phase wrap.

coding_notes: Parameters: freq=2.46 Hz, A=0.266 rad, center=1.607 rad, stance_flex=0.15 rad, swing_lift=0.575 rad, base_z=0.04673357 m, phase0=0.115. Compute pA=freq*t+phase0 then pA-=floor(pA); pB=pA+0.5 then pB-=floor(pB). cA=cos(2*pi*pA), cB=cos(2*pi*pB). Hips: R1=center+A*cA; R2=pi-center+A*cB; L1=pi-center-A*cB; L2=center-A*cA. Swing masks swingA=pA>=0.5, swingB=pB>=0.5; normalized sA=(pA-0.5)*2, sB=(pB-0.5)*2; archA=sin(pi*sA), archB=sin(pi*sB); flexA=where(swingA, stance_flex+swing_lift*archA, stance_flex); flexB=where(swingB, stance_flex+swing_lift*archB, stance_flex). Knees: R3=pi-flexA, L4=pi-flexA, R4=flexB, L3=flexB. Stack q in order R1,R3,R2,R4,L1,L3,L2,L4. Root: x=home['speed']*t, y=0*t, z=base_z*(1+0*t); rpy all 0*t. Contacts: contactA=pA<0.5, contactB=pB<0.5; stack [contactA, contactB, contactB, contactA] for feet order RF,RR,LF,LR. No clipping, no projection, no ground correction; swing phase normalized before sine to avoid wrap discontinuity. Base height constant so no artificial ripple.
